title: Nashville Music Minute — The Record That Built a City
summary: A Midsouth Emmy-winning one-minute rotoscoped short on the 1956 night Nashville became Music City.
overview: A one-minute short told through rotoscoped animation. It follows a legendary 1956 recording session, from the first chord to the neon glow of Music City, and the night Nashville turned from a quiet country town into the heart of the music industry.

cover.alt: Rotoscoped animated still from Nashville Music Minute

film.title: Nashville Music Minute — The Record That Built a City

notes: Published on Vimeo by Silver Spring Pictures, 2025-08-19. Owner confirmed (Nov 2026) this is the piece that won Dan's 2025 Midsouth Emmy.
